newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Senate to vote Wed on Canada trade treaty.
newsitem.headline: Chile Senate to vote Wed on Canada trade treaty.

text.p: The Chilean Senate will begin voting on ratification of a free-trade agreement with Canada at 1830 local time/2330 GMT Wednesday, Senate President Sergio Romero said.

Earlier Wednesday, senators said they expected the treaty to pass. "We will have the first free-trade agreement between Chile and a developed country today," Sen. Sebastian Pinera said on local radio.
The vote will follow an oral report on the free-trade agreement by the Senate's environment committee.
The result of the vote is not expected to be announced until after 1930 local time/0030 GMT Thursday, as senators are allowed to give short speeches accompanying their vote under the chamber's rules.
The agreement will end tariffs on 80 percent of trade between the two countries and phase out the rest over the next 18 years.
The agreement, already ratified by Canada, would take effect the day after approval by the Chilean Senate, which meets in the port city of Valparaiso.
